Fellow Greymanes,
Here are the fixes and improvements that have been added this patch.
 
Major Updates
This patch adds various bug fixes and stability improvements.
 
Update Schedule
The patch is rolling out across all platforms.
Please refer to the Update section below to see the state of the patch for each platform.
 
Update
Steam (PC): Patch available now
Steam (Mac): Patch available now
PlayStation: Patch available now
XBOX: Patch available now
Epic Games Store: Patch available now
Mac App Store: Patch available at a later time (in-progress)
 
Main Improvements
 
Content
  • Fixed an issue where certain bosses would appear transparent during battle.
  • Fixed an issue where crops would stop growing in certain situations.
  • Fixed an issue where crops could not be harvested in certain situations.
  • [Oongka/Damiane] Fixed an issue where the lock status of equipped gear would not be saved.
  • Fixed an issue where the player could not attack while riding the quest objective bear to the village, during the "Scattered Honey Jars" quest.
  • Changed the location of the "Mace of Ambition" so that it can be obtained more easily.
  • Fixed an issue where a large fish carried on the player’s back would disappear when collecting fish from a fish trap.
 
Controls
  • Fixed an issue where the crosshair for "Axiom Force" would appear even when the target was outside its activation range.
  • Fixed an issue where, in certain locations, the camera would remain zoomed in while swimming.
 
Combat / Action
  • Fixed an issue where the Wyvern could not be summoned while in midair.
  • Fixed an issue where "Aerial Roll" traveled an unusually short distance when used after "Aerial Maneuver."
 
Graphics / Settings
  • Fixed an issue where the colors and transparency of certain UI elements would appear abnormally when HDR was enabled.
 
Localization
  • Fixed various localization errors and improved localization quality across all languages.
 
Others
  • Fixed an issue where the game would occasionally crash when loading the cross-save data.
  • Fixed an issue where the character's posture would appear unnatural while riding a mount.
  • Fixed an issue where wagons would occasionally disappear when using the "Escape" function with stolen wagons.
  • Fixed an issue where Kliff would partially sink into the ground when using "Blinding Flash Finisher" on a slope.
